chapters: Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Ramataim gu Sopim gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Elkana gu mar gu Jeroam gu mar gu Eliuu gu mar gu Tou gu mar gu Sup gu Eprateo.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gook gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Anna gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Peninna; mi' dhɨr gu Peninna ga'ra' gu ma'nkam gu' gu Anna cham ga'ra'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ bɨx kiicham jix duñia' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Silo pai' mi'p gook gu ma'nkam gu Eli gu Opni gu Pinees jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu Elkana gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Peninna gu u'vɨ bɨx gu ma'nkam bɨx ma'nkam u'uuvɨ maa'n baasɨ'n.
Gu' gu' gu Anna gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n; na gu' dha'da' gu Anna gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' oi'ñga'; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Elkana gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu Anna gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham jugi gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' jix duñia' tu' tutkɨ mambhɨɨx gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Anna mi' dhɨr ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Silo; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eli ka't daakat ju'ñdharan vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios tu' jix duñia' tu' cham tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu mar gu chio'ñ tu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha' cham jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Eli ka't gu chin.
Gu' gu' gu Anna ua'rgidhimɨk gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Eli.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eli; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va.

Jano' ba' gu Anna jix aa' bham; gio ba' cham gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' tu' jix duñia' gu u'vɨ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ; jano' ba' cham suudai' u'va tu' gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan gu i'ii'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu u'vɨ; na gu' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jano'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eli; gio ba' tu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam na tu juan nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan gu vupui; mi' dhɨr ka't gu u'vɨ gu bhóogɨt jix jugi cham juruuñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu xibh o'lhia vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios suulh tɨɨtɨs gu vaak gu Ramata; gio ba' gu Elkana gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Anna gu u'vɨ gu Jawatan Dios tɨ'ñcho.
Jano' ba' ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Anna gu mar jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Samueel bham; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ gu chio'ñ gu Elkana bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Anna cham jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ; gio ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook ka't; na ba' ka't vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu Elkana gu chio'ñ jix aa'; gio ba' gu vupui xoi'kam tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu u'vɨ jix duu gu mar bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baidhak bɨɨx vaik ali' vaakax gu Epa gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Silo; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't jix ali'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuur aichdhak gu ñi'ook gu Eli.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan tu' jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ juruuñ ju'ñdharan tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix maa.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨx gu tanoolh ka't gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Anna gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu chin jix duñia' bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ na gu' tulhiiñdha'.

Jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch jix bhaan na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' tu'; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'gi'ñchu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chin; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx maachim gu Jawatan Dios jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm gu takarui' kɨɨv gu ñi'ook ga'ra' mui'x gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa gu oidha'; gio ba' jix dhaav tukga'n jix tɨ'ɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' jix búup oo' gampai' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx chiñia'; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook nɨidhat; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' bhaan oipichu'.
Jano' ba' jix nukadham tɨɨt jɨɨgi'ñdham gu' jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukgam; na gu' soo'mchulhdhak ka't jix kavɨk gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan dɨr gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu oidha' maa'n gu kavɨk gu gɨ'kora' gu Mesiias.
Jano' ba' gu Elkana gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Ramata; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eli.
Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Eli jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ko'kmarak machia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx gu ja'tkam ka't na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu maa'nkar jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu chuukug ka't jix duñia' gu novɨ vaik.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx; gio ba' bɨx jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr dhi' duñia' bɨx gu Israelita gu Silo.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam va'k jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan chɨtda gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' jix maa gu chuukug na ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; na gu' cham jix bhɨɨ tu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Kuemen gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ na ja'p; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook jano'; jano' ba' tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ka't uañi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu chichio'ñ makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Samueel gu vaak na jix bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tɨi'chu'.
Na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu naan kutun na jix toja gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' tas na pai' dhuuk bɨɨx gu chio'ñ gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eli jix bhai' aa' gu Elkana gu u'vɨ bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu kai' dhi' gu u'vɨ pai' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr suulh gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Anna gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik gu ma'nkam gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' gu Samueel gɨ'lhidha' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Eli cham gu ñi'ook ka't gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' jix kai bɨx gu ma'nkam duñia' bɨx gu Israeel na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu u'vɨ ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Ba' jix aa'; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook xoi'kam tu'x tuutu'm na gu' tu' bɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam tomaat.
Jano' ba' cham gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' cham jix bhai' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu'; na xoi'kam gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ bhaan gu chio'ñ; na gu' gu' tu' oi'ñdha' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu taat na gu' gu Jawatan Dios kooda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Samueel vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu chichio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Eli; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu vaak gu taat na pai' dhuuk mi'p gu Ejipto gu vaak gu Faraoon.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel na ba' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' tu' gu vaak gu taat bɨx gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' makgɨrxi'ñdha' tu' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; gio ba' nɨidhat gu ma'nkam tu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' ka't tu ñi'ook gu vaak gu taat jiim vupui bhaan tu'; gu' jano' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham pai' dhuuk tu' jix duñia' na gu' tu' nɨidhat ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu taat cham ka't jix bhai'x gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx tu'x jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu vaak.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu chio'ñ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vupui; gu' bɨx gu vaak koi.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨi'ñchudat dhi' gook gu ma'nkam gu Opni gu Pinees; gio ba' koi gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jurtu'nka' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu vaak gu ñi'ook jiim vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' ka't bhɨɨya' jix duñia' gu vaak ɨlhdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tuumiñ jix toja jodai gu chin gu takarui' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' na ba' gu chin gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Samueel gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu Eli; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr cham ka't gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu tanoolh kua' gu Eli jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk gu vupui kua'da' jix duñia' cham gu tanoolh na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel ka't kookos vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios pai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't; gio ba' va'k gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jum duu dɨbaalhga'n.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt gu Samueel; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu Eli; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr na ba' mɨmɨim gu Eli jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' cham tɨɨgim; gio ba' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt jix duñia' gu Samueel; gio ba' kɨkbo gu Samueel suudai' u'va gu Eli jix aa'; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' na ba' tɨɨgim jix aa'; gio ba' gu mar tu' cham tɨɨgim; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Samueel; gio ba' kɨkbo suudai' u'va gu Eli jix aa'; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' na ba' tɨɨgim jano' ba' gu Eli gu Jawatan Dios tɨɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eli gu Samueel; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr tu' mɨmɨim daipu'; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu duukam; gio ba' ka't gu Samueel jix duñia' pai'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jup tɨɨt na ja'p mui'kim; gio ba' gu Samueel jano' ba' gu Samueel jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Samueel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Israeel jix duñia' maatɨt.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Eli bɨx tu'x tu ñi'ook bhaan gu vaak; gio ba' kua'da' gu ñi'ook gio.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na ba' bɨɨx tas gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ma'nkam jix duñia' cham tu' dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Eli gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Eli cham ka't mɨɨjidha' tu' bɨɨx makgɨrxi'ñdha' tu' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel juruuñ jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh jix kupi'ook kiki'ñgob gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Samueel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Eli.
Ba' jix aa' tɨɨt gu Eli gu Samueel; gio ba' gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Samueel; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx tu ñi'ook bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx cham cham tu'; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx cham gu oidha' matgɨm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Israeel dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba gu Samueel ka't jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Silo; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Samueel gu Silo bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix buus gu Israeel gu Pilisteos yooxi' ju'ñdharan gu Eben-eser gu Pilisteos gu Apek.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Israeel ka't vupui bhaan gu Pilisteos yooxi' na ja'p maakobh jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ja'tkam vaak ja'tkam daraa gu Israeel gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu Pilisteos gu Traigamos no'ch gu Silo kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bai'ñpu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch gu novɨ obhɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu ja'tkam gu Silo aichdhak kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gook gu ma'nkam gu Eli gu Opni gu Pinees mi'p bɨɨx kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va yooxi' bɨx gu Israeel jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' yooxi' gu ebreos kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨbiap yooxi'.
Na gu' gu Pilisteos chooto'n ɨɨbhi'ñ na gu' am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' tu' tɨbiap gu Jawatan Dios yooxi'; mi' dhɨr gui'p; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook no'ch va'k jano' cham ka't.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook no'ch gu Kuieen jix duñia' gu noobh dhi' ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk dhi' ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto bɨɨx bɨx oidha' jix gaki.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ebreos na ja'p jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteos tu' gu Israeel ka't jiboi'ññor vaak zel; gio ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' ia'rɨ gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koko'kam gook gu ma'nkam gu Eli gu Opni gu Pinees.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu Benjamiin suudai' u'va mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Silo jajannulhi'ñ gu oidha' bhaan mo'o.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eli ka't daakat ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu i'ii'ñ ka't kuiñcha kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ kiicham gɨ' vaak ja'tkam bɨx kiicham.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Eli jix kai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ suudai' u'va jix duñia' jix maa gu Eli.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu Eli gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui cham gu tanoolh na jix bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Eli; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' mattuda'; gio ba' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Pilisteos gio ka't gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gio gook gu ma'nkam gu Opni gu Pinees koko'kam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't.

Jano' ba' jix duu ka't na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Eli bhaan gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob jix koi; na gu' ka't gu chio'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ka't gu Israeel oo'm.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ gu Pinees ka't gu ja'tkam mia'n tɨiñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't koko'kam gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' gu chio'ñ; na gu' tu' vaak na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam am:―Ja'pji mi'p ju'ñdharan; na gu' cham choo'n na gu' gu mar; gu' cham jix aa' tu' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu ñi'ook gu Ikâbod bham; na gu' bhaan gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't na gu' ka't jix koi gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' gu chio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' bhaan gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Israeel; na gu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios aichdhak dɨr gu Eben-eser gu Asdod.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Pilisteos kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Dagoon jix dhaas ju'ñdharan gu Dagoon.
Jano' ba' buimgidhak gu tanoolh gu Asdod jix búup gu xibh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dagoon gu oidha' vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dagoon suulh pai'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh buimgidhak gu tanoolh gu Dagoon ka't gu oidha' vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' mo'o gu Dagoon gook gu ñi'ook gu noobh mi'p bhaan jix duñia' gu Dagoon gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' kuiñcha jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Dagoon bɨx vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Dagoon ba'k cham gu Dagoon gu Asdod bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Asdod tu' naaka'n bɨɨx gu Asdod bɨx gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ dhi' gu Asdod gui'p; na gu' cham jix duñia' bɨɨx no'ch kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel na gu' gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan no'ch bhaan chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu Dagoon.

Jano' ba' mɨjɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx chiñia' gu Pilisteos gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñchuda' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu Gat; jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p a'lhiok gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan kiicham bɨɨx jix gɨ'; gio ba' tu' naaka'n gu chichio'ñ mii' dhɨr kiicham dɨr bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' mɨjɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Ekroon; gio ba' na ja'p kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va gu Ekroon gu Ekronitas jix maa jiiñak bham; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel kooda' tu' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' mɨjɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx chiñia' gu Pilisteos bham; gio ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel pai' cham tu' gu ja'tkam; na gu' ka't koi'm bɨx kiicham gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham koi jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu ñi'ook kiicham gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu Estubo kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu Pilisteos kɨɨv masaa'n.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Pilisteos tɨɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' tɨkka; gio ba' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñchuda' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Deklaradnos gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨip pai'.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel cham jix bhai'x; gu'; jano' ba' boopoya' dudua'ñdha' gu ñi'ook cham jix ai'chdhix gu ñi'ook gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; na gu' jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' chiñia' gu Pilisteos jixchamaam jix uam jodai jixchamaam jix uam jodai na gu' bɨx namki' gio chiñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' gu novɨ bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu oidha'.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p gu Egipkios gu Faraoon gu i'ii'ñ mi' dhɨr ka't cham bhaai'n jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' jix vɨɨk gook jix duñia' cham ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ali' vaakax gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai; mi' dhɨr.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Bet-semes tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'; mi' dhɨr tu' cham duduaka' gu novɨ cham naaka'n tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix duu; na gu' dhaagɨk gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim gu vaak ali' vaakax.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jix uam jodai bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu Bet-semes tu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jiim gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim cham gu ñi'ook tu' kɨɨ'n tu'; gio ba' chiñia' gu Pilisteos jix bɨɨx duu bhaan bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Bet-semes.
Jano' ba' gu Bet-semes gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tiriik gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu vupui kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' na pai' dhuuk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va yooxi' gu Josuee gu Bet-semita gu ñi'ook; na gu' ka't gu jodai; mi' dhɨr gu u'u maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Lebitas tɨsaa'ñdhak kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't ju'ñdharan mi'p jix uam jodai jix dhaas bhaan mii' dhɨr gu jodai; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Bet-semes gu vaak na jix bhai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ jixchamaam chiñia' gu Pilisteos suulh gu Ekroon gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai gu Pilisteos gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Asdod gu Gasa gu Askaloon gu Gat gu Ekroon.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Pilisteos jixchamaam chiñia' dɨr jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk bɨɨx ka'm taañpu' cham vaak jodai; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai bhaan jix dhaas kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai yooxi' gu Josuee gu Bet-semita bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' jano' ba' naaka'n gu Jawatan Dios gu Bet-semes na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' naaka'n gu ja'tkam mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ; na gu' gu ja'tkam jix dhaas na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu Bet-semes; gio ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan chɨkka jix tɨ'ɨ dɨr no'ch.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kîriat-jearim bham; gio ba' gu Pilisteos jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bhaan.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Kîriat-jearim bhɨɨk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Abinadab; gio ba' jix bhaan gu Eleasar gu mar na ba' jix nukadham kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't dɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Kîriat-jearim mui'x gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel bham; gio ba' tu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Astarot tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baales gu Astarot gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Israeel gu Mispa tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mispa jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gui'p; gio ba' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Samueel gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Mispa.

Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Pilisteos gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mispa jix tɨ'ɨ chiñia' gu Pilisteos bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p a'lhiok naak gu ma'nkam gu Israeel chooto'n choo'n gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Samueel; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook no'ch gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' gu Samueel jix bhɨɨ mar kaneer bii'm maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Samueel gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios jix kai.

Jano' ba' ka't kua' gu Samueel maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gu' gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨɨx jix gɨ' bhaan gu Pilisteos jix bɨɨx duu vupui bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gamai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Mispa bhiadat gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-kar.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Samueel gu jodai jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Mispa gu Sen jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Eben-eser bham; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tɨɨtɨs gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu Pilisteos bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Samueel.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jɨ'dɨlh gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu Israelitas dɨr gu Ekroon bɨɨx ka'm gu Gat bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu Israeel jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel gu Amorreo.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Samueel gu Israeel bɨx gu ñi'ook jix oidha'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bet-el gu Gilgal gu Mispa gu ñi'ook gu Israeel bɨx dhi' ja'tkam pai'.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi' dhɨr gu Rama na gu' ka't gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' pai'x jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't dhaibu gu Samueel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas gu ma'nkam bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu mar maa'nkam mar ka't gu Joel gu tɨɨgɨ' gook gu Abia; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Beer-seba.
Gu' gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu bhóogɨt gu taat va'k bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx daraa gu Israeel jum daa'ñ tɨɨtɨs gu Samueel gu Rama.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ma'nkam cham gu bhóogɨt; na ba' jano' gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p bɨx chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Samueel dhi' gu ñi'ook gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu Samueel gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Samueel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨx tu' tu ñi'ook; na gu' cham tu' jix duñia' jix bhai'x tu' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' jix bhai'x na ba' cham gu gɨ'kora' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' bɨx buimɨi jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tɨtda:―Cha'pim jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam gio bɨndak.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gu' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bhɨɨya' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam kavaayo na ba' vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx; gio ba' vaak ja'tkam xoi'kam gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ oidha' u'va jix bhai' maa'n tu duukam.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gu kai' oidha' u'va na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ tu duukam jix bhai' biipibop gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buimɨi.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gio kakneer boopoya' tu duukam.
Jano' ba' duuñ mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh kuiñcha gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Samueel; gio ba' va'k gui'p; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' no'ch duduaka' gio na ja'p bɨx chɨbɨɨp chulhiiñdha' gu gɨ'kora' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan no'ch gɇ'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñdha' bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Samueel bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maatɨt gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Samueel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bhaan; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix aa' gu Samueel gu chio'ñ gu Israeel; jano' ba' maa'n kiicham.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Benjamiin gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kis gu mar gu Abiel gu mar gu Seor gu mar gu Bekôra gu mar gu Apia gu mar gu chio'ñ gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul biapma' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jiix daam no'x gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' dua'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Kis gu taat gu Sauul; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix aa' gu Kis gu Sauul gu mar; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ jano' bɨndak oi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bamii' tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu oidha' gu Salisa cham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Saalim; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook pai' gu Benjamiin cham.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk tɨɨtɨs gu oidha' gu Sup gu Sauul jix duñia' ga'ra' baidhak; gio ba' jix ai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu taat tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ñi'ook jix duñia' no'ch.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' cham tu'x jai'ch dhi' kiicham gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr bɨx tu'x tu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' aajim; jano' ba'; gio ba' chulhiiñdha' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook pai' tu'.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix aa' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano'; na gu' gu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ na gu' gu takarui' tu' gu ñi'ook cham tañia' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tañia'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu Sauul bham; gio ba' bakia' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n jix toja jodai; na gu' dhi' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na gu' chulhiiñdha' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel no'x gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chɨtda; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; na gu' jano' mɨmɨim jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ka't tɨɨgim gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul jix duñia'; gio ba' xoi'kam tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu kiicham pai' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix tɨ'ɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham gu ñi'ook jix buus gu suudai' gui'p; gio ba' dhi' pai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gui'p; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu'; na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' tɨbiap kiicham gu ja'tkam juraa'n gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar jix bhai'x.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ba'k kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam va'k jix bhai'x jugi; na gu' gu ja'tkam cham jugi bɨɨx ka'm ka't tɨbiap na gu' ka't jix bhai' aa' gu maa'nkar mi' dhɨr jugi koi'cham; na gu' jano' na gu' jano' chɨɨmɨlhdhapu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ kiicham; na pai' dhuuk tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Samueel vupui bhaan busaak na ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh va'k gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't naak gu Samueel bham.

Jano' ba' gu xibh dhi' gu tas tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu chio'ñ gu oidha' gu Benjamiin gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel u'ua'tɨda' gu ja'tkam gu novɨ gu Pilisteos; na gu' tu' tu jiim gu ja'tkam na gu' tu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel jix ñi' gu Sauul gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Miren gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr aapi' gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul gu Samueel tɨjɨɨ'ñ ki'ñgob; gio ba' jix duñia' duukat gu vaak gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu' jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu xibh tu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' vaik gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook na gu' jix duñia' gaagam; gu' chɨkka bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ñi'ook tu' bɨx gu vaak gu taat.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' cham jix duñia' tu' gu mar gu Benjamiin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ali' bopxi'ñ gu Israeel ja'tkam vaak cham gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bɨx ja'tkam vaak bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook nɨidhim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Samueel gu Sauul jix duñia' jix maa pai' koi'cham jix duñia' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bhai'x tu' tu ñi'ook nuuka'n dɨlhkob.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka't bhaan jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Sauul; gio ba' gu Samueel jix aa'; mi' dhɨr ka't; jano' ba' jix dhaas vupui bhaan tu' jugi; na pai' dhuuk na gu' nukadham na ba' tu' na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' amuub gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' gu Sauul jix jugi mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨɨx gu Samueel.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok jix duñia' jix bhai'x kiicham bɨɨx gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai' gu Samueel jup tɨɨt gu Sauul ka't; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' bamii' na ba' tu'; gio ba' jix búup gu Sauul moor mai' gu Samueel.
Ba' jix aa' jix dhaav gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' tu' vupui bhaan; gu' tu' na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' dhaagɨk jano' ba' gu Samueel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨ'ñdhatu' ja'aa bhaan mo'o; gio ba' cham tu' Xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bakia' gook gu chichio'ñ ju'ñdharan tukga'n gu Rakêl gu ñi'ook gu Benjamiin gu Selsa tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gaagam; mi' dhɨr gu taat tu' tɨtda:―Cha'pim tu' gu ñi'ook tu' xoi'kam gu ñi'ook bham; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu mar.

Jano' ba' na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' vaak ja'tkam gu Tabor tu' vaik gu chichio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Bet-el maa'n vaik chiiw vaik gu takarui' vaik gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tulhiiñdha' tu' gook gu takarui' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu noobh.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios pai' gu Pilisteos; na pai' dhuuk baakɨi kiicham chu'p jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix bhai'x vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka' gu chio'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daam dhi' buimɨk gu vupui tu' daraibu' gu novɨ na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' gu Gilgal; gio ba' tu' na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' maa'nkar tai bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm tu' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duu gu Samueel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' bɨx dhi' buimɨk mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chu'p jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix ai bɨɨx gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk bɨx jix maati' gu ñi'ook va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p jix duñia' bɨɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ja'tkam chɨtda maa'n; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu mar gu Kis gu Sauul gio tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' oi'ñdha'; gio ba' chɨkka gu taat gu Por dhi' kuiñcha gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gio gu Sauul tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix utu'ñ jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul jix duñia'; gio ba' duukat jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' na ja'p cham gu Samueel.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook jix aa' gu Samueel.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; gu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Samueel ka't tu ñi'ook cham jix ñi'ñ cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios gu Mispa.
Ba' jix aa' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel gu Ejipto gu novɨ gu Egipkios gu novɨ bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.

Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix nukadham bɨx tulhiiñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' bhaan no'ch; mi' dhɨr jano' jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Samueel bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel ka't bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin ka't ja'tkam vaak gu Matri; gio ba' ka't jix duñia' gu Sauul gu mar gu Kis; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu' cham ka't gaagam.
Jano' ba' tɨkka jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam dɨr gu ñi'ook jiix ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix duñia' buupui tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham cham tu'x jai'ch nɨidhim bɨx gu ja'tkam jano' ba' gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr gu tai gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ua'na u'uan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Samueel bɨx gu ja'tkam maa'n gu vaak; gio ba' gu Sauul gio ka't gu vaak gu Gabaa jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't dhaa.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook chooto'n cham aichdhak; gu'.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Naas gu Ammonita gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' bhaan gu Jabes gu Galaad; gio ba' bɨx gu Jabes gui'p gu Naas; mi' dhɨr gu vupui ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx no'ch tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Naas gu Ammonita jix aa'; gio ba' bɨɨx dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu ñi'ook maa'n bɨx gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu ñi'ook jix duñia' dhi' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' daraa gu Jabes gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu tanoolh na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' soo'mchulhdhak bhɨɨya' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gabaa gu Sauul gui'p dhi' gu ñi'ook maatɨt gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul yooxi' bhaan gu vaakax; gio ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook juraa'n gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu Jabes.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul tɨiñ dhi' gu ñi'ook daak.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax bhañ bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu novɨ bham; gio ba' no'x cham gu Sauul gu Samueel ka't gu ñi'ook gu vaakax; mi' dhɨr choo'n gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ja'tkam moor na ja'p gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Besek; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaik jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨbiap; gio ba' gu Jabes gu Galaad; mi' dhɨr gu xibh gu tas gui'x dodhia'; jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu ñi'ook gu Jabes.
Jano' ba' gu Jabes gui'p; gio ba' gu xibh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan na ba' bɨɨx no'ch bɨx xoi'kam.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul gu ja'tkam vaik baap tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak ja'tkam jix duñia' gu xibh tu' gu Ammonitas bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu jix duñia' cham gu ñi'ook gook tɨtda:―Aañ.
Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam jano' ba' gu Samueel; gio ba' chɨkka am:―Ja'pji; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Sauul bhaan no'ch gu Dad jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ kooda'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; na gu' cham koi gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha' gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Samueel gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gilgal na ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' ka't bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Gilgal tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul gu gɨ'kora' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Gilgal; gio ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jix jai' gu Sauul bɨx gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' naak gu ñi'ook bɨx tu'x jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' tu' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' tu' jix duñia'; gu' gu ma'nkam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook dɨr bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' dhi'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu vaakax oi'ñdha' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook oi'ñdha' tu' jix bhai'x tu' oi'ñdha' tu' jix bhai'x jix duñia' ka't jix bhaan dhaas gu vupui; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu chio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ookdham bhaan gu ñi'ook gio ñi'ookdham dhi' gu tanoolh cham jix duñia' gaagam gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam matgɨm; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu Moisees gu Aaroon jix buusñi tattat gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jano' gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tattat.
Na pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr gu Jakob ka't kia'mi'ñ gu Ejipto tattat tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhañ gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat gu Ejipto jix duu jix daa dhi' pai'.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Siisara ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Asor gu novɨ gu Pilisteos gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab jix duu bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Baales gu Astarot; mi' dhɨr jano' gu novɨ obhɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhañ gu Jerobaal gu Bedaan gu Jeptee gu Samueel jix duñia' gu novɨ obhɨɨ'ñ xikoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' dhaibu buupui gu Naas gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook bhaan no'ch; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook cham ua'tulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook boopoya' gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu ñi'ook na ja'p bhaan tattat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu vupui.

Jano' ba' cham jano' oraa' gu ñi'ook tu' duuñ gu Jawatan Dios maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai'; na ba' jix gɨ' tu' na cham jir bhai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios gu Samueel.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Samueel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham vaak jodai; na gu' bɨx uañi'ñ dhi' cham bhai' gu gɨ'kora' na ba' no'ch.

Jano' ba' gu Samueel jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨx dhi' cham bhai'; gu' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook cham gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham tu' na gu' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' duñia' gu ja'tkam.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't tu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; gio ba' va'k tu' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu'r bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ na gu' jix duñia' tu'x tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu Sauul gu gɨ'kora' oi'ñga'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' ka't gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik jix bhai'x gu Israeel; gio ba' gook jix bhai'x bɨɨx gu Sauul gu Mikmas gu kavɨk gu Bet-el jix bhai'x bɨɨx gu Jonataan gu Gabaa gu Benjamiin; mi' dhɨr bhañ bɨx gu ja'tkam maa'n vaak zel.
Jano' ba' gu Jonataan naaka'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteos ka't gu Pilisteos; gio ba' jix duu gu Sauul kuichdha' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk bɨx gu oidha' bham; mi' dhɨr gu ebreos.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel jix kai chɨtda; gio ba' gu Sauul tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr gio gu Israeel cham bhai' gu Pilisteos; jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Sauul gu Gilgal.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Pilisteos jum daa'ñ na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x jix duñia' gu ja'tkam na ja'p oo' jugii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ yooxi' gu Mikmas tas buusñi gu Bet-aben.
Na gu' gu' gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu ja'tkam ka't gu ja'tkam gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' dhɨt gu ebreos gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan gu oidha' gu Gad gu Galaad; gio ba' gu Sauul ka't gu ñi'ook gu Gilgal bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu tanoolh jurtu'nka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Samueel ka't tu ñi'ook; gu' gu Samueel cham gu Gilgal gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr makgɨrxi maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Samueel; gio ba' gu Sauul jix buus na ba' tulhiiñdha'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Sauul jix aa'; na gu' tu' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham gu tanoolh gu Pilisteos mi'p tɨtda:―Aañ gu Mikmas.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Pilisteos jix dhaav jano' bhaan tu' gu Gilgal tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr maa'nkar tai bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't; na gu' jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Gu' gu' jano' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu chio'ñ bhaan gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' ka't bhaan gu ja'tkam na gu' tu' cham gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu Samueel jix tɨ'ɨ gu Gilgal gu Gabaa gu Benjamiin; gio ba' gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx na ja'p gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Jonataan gu mar gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gabaa gu Benjamiin; gu' gu Pilisteos jix daa gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu Mikmas.
Jano' ba' moor yooxi' gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Opra bhaan gu oidha' gu Sual.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu Bet-oron vaik gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu ñi'ook tu jiim gu Seboim bhaan oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu oidha' gu Israeel cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu Pilisteos tu ñi'ook; na ba' gu ebreos cham xoi'kam gu kuchii u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel jix dhaav gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu chin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm na ba'.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook gu kuchii tu' u'u kavɨk gu novɨ oi'ñdha' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx gu Sauul bɨɨx gu Jonataan gu ñi'ook gu Sauul gu Jonataan gu mar ko'kmarak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteos jix buus gu Mikmas.
Ba' jix aa' gu tanoolh ka't gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Pilisteos mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham jix duu maachim gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul ka't gu oidha' gu Gabaa bɨtaa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'x jai'ch gu Migroon gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx ka't na ja'p gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu Akîas gu mar gu Akîtob xibhɨk gu Ikâbod gu mar gu Pinees gu mar gu Eli jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Silo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham bhai'x gu ja'tkam gu Jonataan.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' gu Jonataan gu ñi'ook gu Pilisteos ka't gu jodai' na jix uam baasɨ'n; gio ba' maa'n gu Boses gu Sene.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Mikmas saagi'ñ bhaan gu Gabaa.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios no'ch; na cham gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jɨɨ'ñdhidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix aa'; gio ba' gu vupui bɨx gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' dhi' bɨndak aagak.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ch gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm bhaan; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' dhi' chulhiiñdha' pai' cham.
Gu' gu' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ch; na gu' jano' ba' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu noobh; jano' ba' dhi' ka't nɨi'ñchudat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteos gui'p; gio ba' gu ebreos gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu jodai' na jix uam.

Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jonataan gu ñi'ook gui'p; gio ba' no'ch chulhiiñchuda' maachim; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Jonataan jix aa' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jonataan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu noobh tɨɨt bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu Jonataan gu ñi'ook bhaan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jonataan bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook ɨraab.
Jano' ba' ka't gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' vaak ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gio gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul dɨr gu Gabaa gu Benjamiin gu ñi'ook ka't jix duñia' tu' baasɨ'n ka't.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu ja'tkam ga'ra' baidhak; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook chɨkka ka't; mi' dhɨr a'lhiok gu ñi'ook gu Jonataan gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu Akîas; gio ba' jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jano' ba' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' ka't kua' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'gi'ñchu' gu Sauul bɨɨx jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu jodai' na jix uam ka't yooxi' gu Pilisteos tu'; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu Sauul jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx ka'm pai'; gio ba' gu kuchii maa'n ka't bhaan duiñchu' ka't jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu ebreos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' bɨɨx gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook va'k tɨbiap bɨɨx xikoolh yooxi' gio suulhgia' suulh na ba' bɨɨx gu Israelitas mi'p bɨɨx gu Sauul bɨɨx gu Jonataan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Israelitas gu jodai' na jix uam gu kavɨk gu Epraim tɨiñ gu Pilisteos gio mii' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-aben.

Gu' gu' gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; na gu' gu Sauul ka't gu ja'tkam bham; mi' dhɨr gu Kualkuiera gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai bɨɨx ka'm ka't jix duñia' obhɨɨ'ñ ka't; jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam cham ka't gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu vupui yooxi'.
Jano' ba' chɨbiapui gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gu' ka't gu novɨ gu chin; na gu' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk cham gu ñi'ook gu Jonataan cham ka't naak na pai' dhuuk gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu novɨ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu chin; gio ba' gu vupui jix bɨɨx duu.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' maa'n gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' gu taat tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam bham; mi' dhɨr ka't gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan; gio ba' gu taat tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jano' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vupui gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook obhɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook jano' jix gɨ' gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Pilisteos dɨr gu Mikmas bɨɨx ka'm gu Ajaloon; gu' gu ja'tkam jix jai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam jix bhɨɨ kakneer ali' vaakax gu oidha' gu ja'tkam jix jugi bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam aa'ñdham gu Sauul gui'p; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jugi bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia'; gio ba' jano' jix bhai'x jix gɨ' gu jodai.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'ga; gio ba' gu ja'tkam ja'xñi maa'n gu ñi'ook kaneer; mi' dhɨr cham bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jugi bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr; jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu novɨ gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Sauul jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't maa'n pai'x gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukaa' bhaan gu Pilisteos bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh cham; mi' dhɨr gui'p; jano' ba' gu vupui xoi'kam tu'; gio ba' jix aa' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bhaan gu Pilisteos kapbhai' gu novɨ gu Israeel gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix maa mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook chɨkka tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dhi' uañi'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios dodhia' gu Israeel tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu mar gu Jonataan koi tɨɨda'; gio ba' cham ka't bɨx gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jonataan gu mar dhi' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam jix aa' gu Sauul; jano' ba' gu vupui xoi'kam tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu gu Jonataan gu Sauul gu ja'tkam jix buus namkidhat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu Jonataan gu mar; mi' dhɨr ka't jix duñia' gu Jonataan.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Jonataan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Jonataan gu ñi'ook jix aa'; jano' ba' tɨɨda' bɨɨx gu novɨ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' koi.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duñia' koi gu Jonataan.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu ja'tkam gu Sauul; gio ba' tu' koi gu Jonataan tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' tulhiiñdha' jix gɨ' gu Israeel cham ka't; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o gu oidha' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu Jonataan na ba' cham vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu Pilisteos jix bɨɨx duu pai'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ xikoolh; gio ba' bhaan gu Moab bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon bhaan gu Edom bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba bhaan gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr pai' ka't.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham tu' naaka'n gu Amalek jix duñia' gu Israeel gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sauul jix bɨɨx duu gu Jonataan gu Isui gu Melki-sua; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' jix gɨ' gu Merab jix ali' gu Mikâl.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ gu Sauul ka't gu Ainoam mar u'vɨ gu Aimaas; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu Abner gu mar gu Ner gu Sauul.
Na gu' na gu' gu Kis gu taat gu Sauul gu Ner gu taat gu Abner jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Abiel.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't jix kavɨk bhaan gu Pilisteos bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Sauul; gio ba' no'x gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ jix kavɨk gu chio'ñ baidhak.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhañ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu gu Amalek gu Israeel; na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt na pai' dhuuk gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amalek bɨx palhɨɨp; gio ba' cham tu'; mi' dhɨr gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ a'aalh kakneer jix ai gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jum daa'ñ gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Telaim jix bhai'x tɨɨt mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' bai'ñpu' gu Sauul kiicham gu Amalek jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu Kineo; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Amalek na ba' cham tu' bɨɨma'n bɨɨx; na pai' dhuuk tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ejipto; jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix gu Kineo tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Amalek.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul naaka'n gu Amalek dɨr gu abila bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sur gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu Agag gu gɨ'kora' gu Amalek gu' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Agag tutkɨ kakneer gu vaakax jix gɨ' gu chuukug bɨx jix bhai'; na cham cham tu' duu; gu' bɨx ka't.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Samueel bham.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Sauul na gu' tu' cham tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Samueel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Samueel na ba' tu' gu Sauul gu xibh; gio ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Samueel bham; mi' dhɨr gu Sauul tu' tɨbiap gu Karmel tu' jix duñia' mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu Gilgal.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel jano' ba'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax dhi' tu' bɨɨx maatɨt.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix aa'; gio ba' gu Amalek jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu ja'tkam tutkɨ kakneer na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; gu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook dhi' gu tukaa'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix ali' gu vupui cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mo'o bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios tu' Xoi'kam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' tu' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' u'ua'tulhdhix gu Amalek tu jiim bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham naak gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix aa' gu Samueel; gio ba' va'k naak gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhañ gu Agag gu gɨ'kora' gu Amalek gu Amalekitas.
Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu Gilgal.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel; gio ba' juraa'n gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx maa'nkar tai bhaan na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tutkɨ makgɨrxi'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug.
Na gu' na gu' na ja'p uañi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ na ja'p duiñxim tu'; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gio tu' jix bhai'x na ba' cham gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Samueel; gio ba' tu' uañi'ñ; na jix bhai'x tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Samueel jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix bhai'x na ba' cham gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gɨɨsɨk gu Samueel na ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tu' jix maa tɨtmo tutkɨ tu'.
Jano' ba' gio gu Benkedor gu Israeel cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; na gu' cham gu chio'ñ na ba'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' uañi'ñ; gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan daraa gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Israeel; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Samueel bhaan gu Sauul jix duñia' gu Sauul gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu Samueel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Agag gu gɨ'kora' gu Amalek; mi' dhɨr gu Agag suudai' u'va; jano' ba' jix aa' gu Agag; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim koi'm.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel; gio ba' na ja'p gu kuchii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ cham gu ma'nkam gu naan ka't cham gu mar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Samueel jix duñia' bapaalh gu Agag vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Gilgal.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Samueel gu Rama gu Sauul jix tɨ'ɨ gu vaak gu Gabaa gu Sauul.

Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr jix ñi' gu Samueel gu Sauul bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Samueel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul; gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu Sauul gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Samueel; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk tu' jix xuaak gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix bhai'x na ba' cham gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel gu inke bɨ'ñdhatu' tu' gu Isaii gu Bet-leem; na gu' gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu jiim tu' gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mu'aa; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨndak gu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios tɨbiap.
Jano' ba' mɨmɨim gu Isaii gu maa'nkar tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jix duu gu Samueel na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bet-leem daraa kiicham moor bɨɨx ɨɨbhi'ñ gui'p; mi' dhɨr namkia'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar; jano' ba' jix bhaan gu Isaii gu ma'nkam jup tɨɨt gu maa'nkar.
Ba' jix aa' ka't na ja'p tɨɨtɨs jix ñi' gu Eliab; gio ba' tɨɨda' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Samueel; na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix gɨ' dhi' na gu' tu'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu chio'ñ; na gu' gu chio'ñ vupui bhaan gu vupui gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Isaii gu Abinadab tu' jix duu gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Samueel; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu Isaii gu Samma; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu Isaii kɨɨv gu ma'nkam vupui bhaan gu Samueel; gu' gu Samueel jix aa' gu Isaii; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suulhgia'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel gu Isaii; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix ali' gu ñi'ook kakneer; jano' ba' jix aa' gu Samueel gu Isaii; na gu' cham meesa bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; jano' ba' bamii'.

Jano' ba' gu Samueel jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨ'ñdhatu' tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; gio ba' dɨr mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr jix búup gu Samueel gu Rama.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix ai'chdhix gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul gui'p; gio ba' jano' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios tu'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan tu duukam vupui bhaan tu' oi'ñdha' kuichdha' gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk na ba' na pai' dhuuk ua'tulhi'ñ bhaan tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jano' oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa' bham; gio ba' tu' buupui gu mar gu Isaii gu Bet-leem kuichdha' jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Isaii bham; gio ba' gu Dabii gu mar bɨɨx kakneer.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Isaii gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va chiiw bhañ gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Dabii gu mar.
Jano' ba' bai'ñpu' gu Dabii gu Sauul juruuñ vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jai' ka't gu ñi'ook kutun kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul bhañ a'ga gu Isaii; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu Sauul gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu novɨ; gio ba' gu Sauul ga'ra' ka't tutkɨ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos jum daa'ñ chugi'ñ na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sokô gu Judaa yooxi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sokô gu Aseka gu Epes-dammim.
Jano' ba' gio gu Sauul gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel jum daa'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu Alkornokue bhaan gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos mi'p bhaan gu kavɨk baasɨ'n tu' gu Israeel ka't bhaan gu kavɨk baasɨ'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix buus jano' ba' gu chio'ñ yooxi' gu Pilisteos jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook vaak ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Goliat gu Gat ga'ra' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o tu' tɨi'chu' bɨɨx; gio ba' ka't jixchamaam jix bhai'x gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk jodai kutun kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'u kavɨk ka't na ja'p ga'ra' jix kavɨk jodai u'u kavɨk jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' tu' kutun kavɨk vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix maa jiiñak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' tu' gu Pilisteo gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Sauul gu Eskoged tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨɨ' no'ch duduaka' tu duukam; gio ba' tu' chɨɨ' gu ñi'ook boopoya' tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteo; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' yooxi' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Sauul bɨx gu Israeel dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Pilisteo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chooto'n ɨɨbhi'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't gu mar mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Eprateo gu Bet-leem gu Judaa gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Isaii ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam; gio ba' ka't dhi' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Sauul jix duñia' jix gɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' vaik gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Isaii gu Sauul bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' vaik gu ma'nkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' gu Eliab maa'nkam mar gook gu Abinadab vaik gu Samma.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't jix ali'; gio ba' bhiadat vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Dabii ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Sauul na ba' kakneer gu taat gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu Pilisteo gu xibh gu xumai oo'm gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Isaii gu Dabii gu mar; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ jano' na ba' gu ja'tkam gu Epa dhi' kai'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ja'tkam mambhɨɨx gu takarui' jootom vaak ja'tkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ja'tkam mambhɨɨx bii'm tu' gu ja'tkam gu i'ii'ñ jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul bɨx gu Israeel mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Alkornokue bɨɨx gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii gu xibh jix duñia' kakneer gu ñi'ook jix nukadham ka't bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Isaii ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' na ba'.
Na gu' na gu' gu Israelitas na ja'p gu Pilisteos mi'p jir bɨx bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu novɨ nukadham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dai'bus; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam tu' mi'p gu i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' kua' a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook vaak ja'tkam gu Goliat gu Pilisteo gu Gat jix buus gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix kai gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Israeel jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ko'kmarak choo'n.

Jano' ba' maa'n gu Israeel chɨtda; gio ba' cham jix duñia' buupui mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr chɨɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx namkɨm maa'n mar u'vɨ gu vaak gu taat gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii ju'ñdharan mi'p bham; na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duu gu chio'ñ chɨɨ' dhi' gu Pilisteo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel na gu' chɨkka dhi' gu Pilisteo gu ñi'ook na ba' gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix aa' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ chɨɨ'.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñiokda' gu Eliab xibhɨk jix gɨ' bɨɨx mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu Eliab daak bhaan gu Dabii; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix bhai'x chɨkka tɨtda:―Cha'pim mii' dhɨr kakneer oidha' jix gaki tu' kakasnira' gu i'ii'ñ na ba' tɨbiap.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jano' dhi' cham gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam na ja'p maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Dabii ka't tu ñi'ook na ja'p vupui bhaan gu Sauul.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Sauul; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha; mi' dhɨr tu duukam bɨɨx dhi' gu Pilisteo.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu Dabii; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan mii' dhɨr gu Pilisteo na ba' bɨɨx; na gu' tu' gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham dɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' tu duukam ka't bipia'dam kakneer gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maavɨt mar kaneer.
Jano' ba' busaak tu' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chin; gio ba' tu' jix búup bhaan tu' jootos gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' jum duu maavɨt jum duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam; na gu' dhi' gu Pilisteo gu ñi'ook ka't na ja'p maa'n na gu' tu' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' maavɨt gio jix duñia' gu novɨ dhi' gu Pilisteo; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Sauul gu Dabii; jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii jix dhaas bhaan mo'o gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu kuchii bhaan jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook jiim na gu' cham pai' dhuuk ka't; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Sauul; na gu' tu' cham jiim bɨɨx dhi' na gu' cham pai' dhuuk; jano' ba' gu Dabii mii' dhɨr tu'x.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ jixchamaam gu jodai gu ñi'ook jix duu jix dhaas bɨɨx gu novɨ jix duñia' bhaan gu Pilisteo.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiim gu Dabii kutun kavɨk vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Pilisteo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ñi' gu Dabii jix duñia'; na gu' ka't biapma' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Pilisteo gu Dabii; gio ba' jix duñia' tu' gagai' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨɨx kaapak gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Pilisteo gu Dabii; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu chuukug gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vaakax yooxi'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Pilisteo; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨɨx gu kuchii u'u kavɨk kutun kavɨk; gu' tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' kapbhai' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu Pilisteos gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vaakax gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' bɨx cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx dhi' gu Jawatan Dios cham dodhia' bɨɨx gu kuchii u'u kavɨk; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨ'ñdham kapbhai' gu novɨ gu noobh.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu Pilisteo jix búup na ba' tu' jix duñia' bhaan gu Dabii jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dai'bus bhaan gu Pilisteo.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu novɨ jix bhɨɨ gu jodai bɨɨx tu' naaka'n gu Pilisteo jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu jodai jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu Pilisteo bɨɨx gu jodai; gio ba' tu' naaka'n gu Pilisteo cham mambhɨɨx gu Dabii gu kuchii gu novɨ.
Gu' gu' dai'bus gu Dabii jix dhaas bhaan gu Pilisteo dhaagɨk gu kuchii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx mo'o; gio ba' na ja'p gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook jix koi jiboi'ññor.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu Israeel gu Judaa jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhiadat gu Pilisteos bɨɨx ka'm kiki'ñgob gu Ekroon; gio ba' ia'rɨ gu Pilisteos gu bhóogɨt gu Saraim bɨɨx ka'm gu Gat gu Ekroon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Pilisteos vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ mo'o gu Pilisteo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem gu' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook vaak zel.

Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk gu Sauul jix ñi' gu Dabii busaak jix ai bɨɨx gu Pilisteo gu Abner gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Abner chɨkka gu mar mii' dhɨr biapma' gu Abner jix aa'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' cham tu'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook chɨkka gu mar mii' dhɨr biapma'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kooda' gu Pilisteo gu Abner jix bhɨɨ vupui bhaan gu Sauul ua'tulhdhidha' mo'o gu Pilisteo gu novɨ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' biapma' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu Dabii jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu mar tu duukam gu Isaii gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook ñiokda' bɨɨx gu Sauul gu i'ii'ñ gu Jonataan ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Dabii gu Jonataan na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jix bhɨɨ mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu taat.
Na gu' jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jonataan gu Dabii na gu' dha'da' na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jonataan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ga'ra' bhaan jix maa gu Dabii bɨɨx ka'm gu kuchii gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' busaak gu Dabii pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duu gu Sauul gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu vupui bɨx gu ja'tkam gu vupui gu Sauul.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kooda' gu Pilisteo moor gu u'vɨ bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Israeel jix duñia' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' alabaa'n gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu Sauul naaka'n gu Dabii mambhɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' bhaam gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook gu vupui; gio ba' gu Dabii jix maa mambhɨɨx tu'; mi' dhɨr cham uañi'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' dɨr mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak bɨɨx bhaan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; gio ba' gu Dabii bɨɨx gu novɨ na ja'p gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr ka't u'u kavɨk gu novɨ gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul jix duñia' bham; gio ba' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gook mui'kim jix ai'chdhix gu Dabii.
Na gu' gu' gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx ka't gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix ai'chdhix gu Sauul tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x; gio ba' busaak vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' gu' bɨx gu Israeel gu Judaa dha'da' gu Dabii na gu' busaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu Dabii; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Merab mar u'vɨ jix gɨ' gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix kavɨk bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios; gu' gu Sauul chɨtda; gio ba' cham ka't gu novɨ bhaan gu' gu novɨ gu Pilisteos ka't bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' chɨkka jix duñia' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' ja'tkam vaak gu taat gu Israeel na ba' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' tɨbiap gu ñi'ook gu Merab mar u'vɨ gu Sauul ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii ka't gu u'vɨ gu Adriel gu Meolatita.
Gu' gu' gu Mikâl mar u'vɨ gu Sauul dha'da' gu Dabii; gio ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' ka't jix duñia' na ba' gu novɨ gu Pilisteos ka't bhaan; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Sauul gu Dabii; jano' ba' bɨɨx ka' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu ñi'ook ɨxchuixim gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' tu' xoi'kam bɨx tu' xoi'kam; jano' ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook maatɨt gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Dabii jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu chio'ñ gampai' matgɨm jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul jix maa bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Dabii.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' ja'xñi gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Pilisteos na ba' ka't obhɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora'; gu' gu Sauul gu Dabii gu noobh gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Dabii dhi' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Dabii na ba' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' na ja'p cham ka't jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii ta'tak bɨɨx gu ja'tkam tu' naaka'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu Dabii gu ñi'ook kapbhai' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' na ba' jum duu gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu Sauul jix maa mar u'vɨ gu Mikâl gu u'vɨ.
Gu' gu' gu Sauul ñɨi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx gu Dabii mar u'vɨ gu Mikâl dha'da'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; gio ba' ka't gu Sauul bhaamki'ñdha' gu Dabii bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix buus chiñia' gu Pilisteos; gio ba' na ja'p jix buus gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii bɨx tu duukam gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr ka't gu tɨɨgɨ' gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu Jonataan gu mar bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu Dabii; gu' gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul dha'da' gu Dabii.
