Jano' ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu Sauul gu taat jix duñia' kooda'; na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ju'ñdharan gu taat yooxi' pai'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook tu' gu taat tu' maachim.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan xoi'kam gu Dabii gu Sauul gu taat; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan tu duukam gu Dabii matgɨm tu' bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr va'k buimɨi tu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'.

Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' jix dhaas gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' naaka'n gu Pilisteo gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha' bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ɨ'ɨr gu Dabii cham kuiñcha.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Sauul gu ñi'ook gu Jonataan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios cham koi.
Jano' ba' tɨɨt jano' ba' gu Jonataan gu Dabii gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu Sauul juruuñ vupui bhaan na ja'p va'k.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' jix buus gu Dabii bhaan gu Pilisteos tu' naaka'n bɨɨx jix gɨ' jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu Sauul; gio ba' kua' daakat gu vaak ga'ra' u'u kavɨk gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii ka't bɨɨx gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii bɨɨx u'u kavɨk; gu' jix ai'chdhix vupui bhaan gu Sauul naaka'n bɨɨx u'u kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu Dabii gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Dabii na ba' gu xibh; gu' gu Mikâl gu u'vɨ jix ñi'ñ gu Dabii bham; mi' dhɨr tu' cham dodhia' gu oidha' dhi' gu tukaa' gu xibh ka' jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mikâl gu Dabii gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Mikâl dhi' jix dhaas bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhaan dhaas bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Sauul bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii jix aa'; gio ba' ka'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul tɨip na ba' gu Dabii bham; gio ba' na ba'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baap dhi' ka't gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Mikâl; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ñi'ook bhaamki'ñdha' gu Mikâl jix aa' gu Sauul; na gu' jix aa'; jano' ba' tu'; gio ba' tu' cham tu' kooda'.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va gu Samueel gu Rama bɨx gu Sauul ka't gu ñi'ook bɨɨx; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Samueel gu Najot.
Jano' ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Sauul bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu Najot gu Rama.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii chu'p jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' gu Samueel ka't gu tanoolh na jix bhai'; gio ba' ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Sauul gio jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't maachim gu Sauul bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Sauul tɨip jix duñia' gio jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Rama; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' suudai' jix gɨ' gu Sokô tɨtda:―¿Jax bham; mi' dhɨr duukat gu Samueel gu Dabii ka't tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu Najot gu Rama.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Najot gu Rama; gio ba' gio suudai' u'va bhaan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu Najot gu Rama.

Jano' ba' gio gu ñi'ook jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Samueel tɨbiaptuda bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gio gu Sauul tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Najot gu Rama suudai' u'va vupui bhaan gu Jonataan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu' na cham jir bhai' uañi'ñ bhaan gu taat gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' matgɨm; mi' dhɨr cham koi; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat matgɨm jix gɨ' tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n cham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu taat dhi' cham ka't.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook kavɨk aa' bham; gio ba' gu taat tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan gu vupui; na gu' cham dhi' gu Jonataan na gu' cham jix duñia' jix duu; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' koi'm.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan gu Dabii; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Jonataan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh ka't gu masad tu' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' jugi; gu' tu' kiicha' yooxi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai vaik gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu taat jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' daipu'; na gu' jix jai' tu' jootom gu Bet-leem kiicham na gu' bɨx gu ma'nkam namki' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Bien bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam; gu' tu'.

Jano' ba' jix duu xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx tu duukam tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak; gio ba' tu' tu' na cham jir bhai' cham tu'x jai'ch tu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr va'k xoi'kam tu' gu taat na ba' jix ai bhaan tu' cham ka't tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Jonataan; gio ba' chɨkka maa'n aa'ñdham gu ñi'ook tu' gu taat tu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan gu Dabii; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi'; mi' dhɨr moor yooxi'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jonataan gu Dabii; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu taat gu xibh dhi' gu tas mi' dhɨr gu xibh xoi'kam na ba' bɨɨx gu Dabii tu' jano' ba' cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jonataan dhi'; gu' tu' gu taat gu ñi'ook cham bhai' gio tu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak na ja'p ka't bɨɨx gu taat.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios; gu' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ jix koi.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu vaak; na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios maa'n obhɨɨ'ñ gu Dabii gu oidha' gu Jonataan gu vaak tu' gu ta'm na tu maakia' gu Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jonataan ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu vaak gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ obhɨɨ'ñ gu Dabii.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jonataan ñi'ook kavɨk aa' gu Dabii na gu' dha'da' na gu' dha'da' na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan; na gu' gu xibh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu masad tu' ka' baas gu ñi'ook na gu' gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' gu Estaraas vaik gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨlhdham pai' dhi' gu jodai' na jix uam gu tanoolh tu jiim ju'ñdharan gu jodai gu Esel.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik bhaan mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix toja.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' tu jiim; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix bhai'x tu'; na gu' tu' ɨlhdham na gu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ cham tu' cham tu'x jai'ch cham bhai' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook ka't gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' namkia' ka't gu masad jix daa gu gɨ'kora' jugi gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix daa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan gu Jonataan jix búup jix daa gu Abner gu ñi'ook gu Sauul pai' gu Dabii ka't cham tu'x jai'ch.
Ba' jix aa' gu' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Sauul cham cham tu' na gu' chɨtda; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr cham.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak gook gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu masad ka't gio gu ñi'ook gu Dabii ka't cham tu'x jai'ch; gio ba' gu Sauul jix aa' gu Jonataan gu mar; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham tu' tɨbiap jugi gu mar gu Isaii gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jonataan jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-leem.

Ba' jix aa'; na gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na gu' tañia' gu maa'nkar chulhiiñdha' gu ma'nkam kiicham xibhɨk tu' jix duñia'; na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui jano' gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' cham tu' tɨbiap gu vaak na jix bhai' gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jonataan; gio ba' gu mar jix maat cham tu' gu mar gu Isaii na ba' gu jodai' na jix uam na ba' gu jodai' na jix uam xi'ɨraam gu naan.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Isaii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu oidha' tu' ka' gu ñi'ook tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; na gu' jano' na gu' tu' koi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan gu taat gu Sauul; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook koi gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' pai' gu Jonataan gu taat ka't gu tanoolh na jix bhai' kooda' gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Jonataan gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham jix jugi gu takarui' gook gu tanoolh gu masad; na gu' ga'ra' kuiñcha gu Dabii na gu' gu taat ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu xibh jix buus gu Jonataan yooxi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Dabii jix ali' bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' tu jiim tu'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jonataan ka't gu Jonataan jix maa jiiñak bhaan gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jonataan bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham tu' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jonataan suudai' u'va gu Jawatan.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook matgɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jonataan gu Dabii.
Ba' jix aa' jix maa gu Jonataan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix búup gu Dabii baasɨ'n saagi'ñ tu' vaik mui'kim bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha'; gio ba' maa'n gu ñi'ook maa'n bɨɨx gu Dabii gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jonataan gu Dabii; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kai' na ba' bɨɨx tas; jano' ba' jix búup ka't; gio ba' gu Jonataan chɨbiapui kiicham.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Dabii gu Nob gu Aimelek jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aimelek jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' soo'mchulhdhak bɨndak.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Aimelek; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr soo'mchulhdhak dhi' tu' jootsa' tu' jix duñia'; jano' ba' tu' nɨi'ñchudat tɨɨda' pai'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ jixchamaam gu takarui' bakia'.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Dabii; gio ba' cham no'ñ gu takarui' kua'dam gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ñ gu takarui'; gu' tu' jix duñia' gu u'vɨ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; na pai' dhuuk tɨɨda' gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr na pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu jɨɨgi'ñdham gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.

Na gu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix maa gu takarui' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' cham ka't gu takarui' tɨkiix jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jaisaidhat gu takarui' gu tanoolh jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh ka't maa'n tu duukam gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Doeg gu Idumeo gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bipia'dam gu Sauul.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Aimelek; na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ u'u kavɨk gu kuchii na gu' cham gu novɨ gu kuchii tu' gu ñi'ook na gu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' ka't.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix aa'; gio ba' gu kuchii gu Goliat gu Pilisteo tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Alkornokue jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix bhɨɨ; na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr matgɨm na ja'p; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu Dabii mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul suudai' u'va gu Akîs gu gɨ'kora' gu Gat.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu Akîs gui'p; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' cham alabaa'n bham; mi' dhɨr naaka'n gu Sauul gu Dabii mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix dhaas gu i'ii'ñ dhi' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' choo'n gu Akîs gu gɨ'kora' gu Gat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu noobh kiki'ñgob gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Akîs tu duukam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñɨi'ñ gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu jiim na ba' vupui bhaan tu' ka't jix ai gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu Yeendose gu Dabii gu ñi'ook jumpa'n gu Adullam; gio ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam bɨx gu vaak gu taat tɨɨtɨs.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx ka't bɨx gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' baidhak na ja'p gu chichio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' ka't gu Dabii gu Mispa gu Moab gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ gu taat gu naan bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab jix daa bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Dabii juruuñ gu kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' gu Gad gu Dabii; gio ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu kavɨk gu oidha' gu Judaa; mi' dhɨr gu Dabii ta'tak suudai' u'va gu aret.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Sauul na ja'p ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii mi'p bɨɨx; gio ba' ka't jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Gabaa bɨtaa'n gu u'u gu Rama ga'ra' u'u kavɨk gu novɨ bɨx mi'p.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi'p; gio ba' jix duñia' jano' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin; mi' dhɨr maa'n gio bɨx gu mar gu Isaii oidha' u'va bɨx bopxi'ñ.

Na bɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch naak na ja'p gu mar tu' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu mar gu Isaii tu' oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook tu' na ja'p gu mar tu' jix duñia' tu duukam bhaan tu' na ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Doeg gu Idumeo ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu duukam gu Sauul; gio ba' tu' gu mar gu Isaii suudai' u'va gu Nob gu Aimelek gu mar gu Aitob.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gio jix maa gu kuchii gu Goliat gu Pilisteo.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Aimelek gu mar gu Aitob bɨx gu vaak gu taat jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan mi'p gu Nob; gio ba' bɨx tɨɨtɨs gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu mar gu Aitob; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu Jawatan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan tu' gu mar gu Isaii na pai' dhuuk tu' chɨɨdak gu takarui' gu kuchii gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix búup bhaan tu' jix duñia' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Aimelek gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' chɨkka tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' jix duñia' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' kua'da' tu' dɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu'; gio ba' cham jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam tu' bɨx gu vaak gu taat; na gu' tu duukam matgɨm dhi' jix gɨ' tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' cham jix duñia' koi gu Aimelek tu' bɨx gu vaak gu taat.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't xikoolh; gio ba' mia'n jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gio gu novɨ bɨɨx gu Dabii pu'ñir cham; gu' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' cham jix duñia' gu noobh na ba' kooda' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Doeg; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu Doeg gu Idumeo bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix bhai'x jixchamaam gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Nob kiicham jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu u'vɨ a'aalh gu vaakax gu ñi'ook kakneer bɨx.
Gu' gu' maa'n gu ma'nkam gu Aimelek gu mar gu Aitob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abiatar gu ñi'ook gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu Abiatar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii na ja'p gu Sauul ka't jix koi jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Abiatar; gio ba' tu' bhai'x kua' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Doeg gu Idumeo ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr tu' jix maa bua' bhaan bɨx gu vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jum i'obh; na gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gio; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam tu' dhi'.
Jano' ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteos gu Keila.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' tu jiim gu ñi'ook dhi' ja'tkam gu Pilisteos gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Pilisteos gu Keila.
Gu' gu' mi'p bɨɨx gu Dabii gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ch gu Judaa dhi' bɨɨx ɨɨbhi'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Keila bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr bamii' gu Keila tu' kapbhai' gu noobh gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Dabii bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Keila gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Pilisteos tu' naaka'n bɨɨx jix gɨ'; gio ba' gu Dabii gu Keila.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abiatar gu mar gu Aimelek gu Dabii gu Keila suudai' u'va gio bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Sauul gu Dabii ka't tɨbiap gu Keila; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh; na gu' gu ñi'ook kiicham bɨɨx kiki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul bɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' jix dhaav gu Keila jix duñia' gu Dabii.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu Sauul cham bhai' bhaan gu Abiatar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu duukam juraa'n gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ai bhaan gu Keila cham tu' duu kiicham kuiñcha.

Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Keila gu noobh gu ñi'ook gu Sauul na ja'p tu duukam juraa'n naak gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' kapbhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Keila tu' gu chichio'ñ gu noobh gu Sauul gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Te kapbhai'.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii jano' ba' jix búup bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam moor gu Keila jix bɨɨx duu baasɨ'n; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Sauul na ja'p gu Dabii ka't gu Keila; mi' dhɨr jix buus.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't oidha' jix gaki gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix daa gu kavɨk oidha' jix gaki gu Sip; gio ba' gu Sauul bɨx gu tanoolh gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham do'ñcho gu noobh.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Dabii gu Sauul ka't gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki gu Sip.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul suudai' u'va gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham jum i'obh cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu Sauul gu taat tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Israeel tu' jix duñia' gook mi' dhɨr tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Sauul gu taat.
Jano' ba' ba'k jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jonataan gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Sip a'ga gu Sauul gu Gabaa; gio ba' cham gu Dabii gu jodai' na jix uam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu akîla gu novɨ tu jiim oidha' jix gaki.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' jano' jootom bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ no'ch kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' pai' juraa'n tɨɨt chɨkka ka't buupui; na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx pai' tu' bɨɨx tu' tu jiim bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; na tu' gu oidha' tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix búup jix bɨɨx duu gu Sip vupui bhaan gu Sauul; gu' gu Dabii gu ja'tkam mi'p oidha' jix gaki gu Maoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨ'n oidha' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Sauul bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; gu' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii jix dhaav gu jodai' na jix uam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki gu Maoon; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Sauul jix kai chɨ'ɨɨk gu Dabii oidha' jix gaki gu Maoon.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Dabii bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu Dabii na ba' tu' vupui bhaan gu Sauul; gu' gu Sauul gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu ja'tkam na ba' jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' suudai' u'va mattuda' gu Sauul bham; na gu' jix ai na gu' gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul gu ñi'ook gu Dabii ta'tak bhaan gu Pilisteos; gio ba' dhi' kuiñcha jix dhaas mii' dhɨr pai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Sela-amma-lekot.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul gu ñi'ook gu Dabii ta'tak bhaan gu Pilisteos; gio ba' dhi' kuiñcha jix dhaas mii' dhɨr pai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Sela-amma-lekot.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix tɨ'ɨ jix daa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk gu Engaddi.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteos jix maa aa'ñdham bham; gio ba' gu Dabii oidha' jix gaki gu Engaddi.
Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu Sauul vaik jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Israeel ka't gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu jodai' na jix uam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu kakkavɨk.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer gu bhóogɨt pai' ka't jumpa'n chɨbiapui gu Sauul tɨɨt; gio ba' gu Dabii mi'p jumpa'n.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr kapbhai' bhaamki'ñdha' gu noobh jix duu bɨɨx na ja'p tu'; jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii gu ñi'ook jugii'ñ gu Sauul.
Na gu' mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ gu Dabii koi'm na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook jugii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu novɨ bhaan; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii bɨɨx gu ñi'ook cham bhaan gu Sauul; gio ba' gu Sauul gamai' jumpa'n ka't gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' gio gu Dabii jix búup mi' dhɨr gamai' jumpa'n jix maa jiiñak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p gu Sauul gu Dabii gu vupui gu oidha' tu' jix duu tu jiim.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Sauul; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Dabii jix duñia' cham bhai'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' buupui gu ñi'ook gu vupui na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu noobh jumpa'n; na gu' gui'p tu' mu'aa gu' tu' na gu' tu ñi'ook; na gu' cham gu novɨ bhaan gu Jawatan na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat jugii'ñ gu novɨ; na gu' tu' jugii'ñ cham tu'; mi' dhɨr jix maati' tu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch cham bhai' tu' gu novɨ tu' uañi'ñ bhaan tu'; jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx tu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu Jawatan Dios; gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu novɨ cham ka't bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix bhai'x; na ba' gu novɨ cham ka't bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' bhaan chɨkka tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel chɨkka o'bhagi'ñchu' gagai' jix koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jir bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha gu novɨ.
Ba' jix aa' ka't na ja'p gu Dabii jix bɨɨx duu a'ga dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Sauul; gio ba' cham dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu Dabii gu Sauul gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bhai' tu' bɨɨx xoi'kam tu' bɨɨx cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook xoi'kam; na gu' cham jix koi gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu noobh.
Na gu' na gu' chɨkka gu ñi'ook bhaamki'ñdha' kiicha' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' bɨɨx xoi'kam gu ñi'ook dhi' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' na ja'p tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tu' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook dhi'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duñia' gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu vaak gu taat; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr ka't gu Sauul gu vaak gu Dabii gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Samueel jum daa'ñ bɨx gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Rama; gio ba' jix búup gu Dabii ka't oidha' jix gaki gu Paraan.
Jano' ba' gu Maoon ka't gu chio'ñ ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Karmelo ka't gu bhóogɨt ga'ra' vaik jix bhai'x kakneer jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't bakia' kakneer gu Karmelo.

Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ka't gu Nabal gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ gu Abigail; gio ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai' nɨidhidha'; gu' gu chio'ñ ka't jix bhai'x tomaat; jano' ba' ka't gu ma'nkam gu Kaleb.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Dabii oidha' jix gaki gu Nabal gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' bhañ gu Dabii mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Karmelo tu' gu Nabal ñio'kdha' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' ja'xñi; na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ ja'tkam vaak bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jano' bipia'dam jix duñia' dhi' bɨɨx no'ch cham pai' dhuuk gu kavɨk tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' dhi' gu Karmelo.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' ja'tkam nɨidhidha' gu vupui jix bhai' gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu novɨ tu duukam gu mar gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gui'p gu Nabal bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Dabii.
Ba' jix aa' gu Nabal gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; gio ba' chɨkka gu Dabii chɨkka gu mar gu Isaii gu Mukos tu duukam cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ tu' jano' gu takarui' gu suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu chichio'ñ cham tu' duukat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii suulh gu bhóogɨt tɨɨtɨs gui'p gu Dabii bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu kuchii; mi' dhɨr maa'n gu kuchii; jano' ba' gio gu Dabii gu kuchii; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu Dabii na ja'p gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa aa'ñdham gu Abigail gu u'vɨ gu Nabal bham; gio ba' gu Dabii bhañ oidha' jix gaki tulhiiñdha' chulhiiñdha' tu'.
Gu' gu' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk tu' matgɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx gu ñi'ook jix maat bɨɨx dhi' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' vaak jodai gu tanoolh gu tukaa' bɨx gu tanoolh dhi' bɨɨx kakneer.
Na gu' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia' na gu' cham bhai' bɨx bhaan chulhiiñdha' bhaan bɨx gu vaak; na gu' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook cham bhai' cham cham tu'x jai'ch ñiokda'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Abigail jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui' gook o'jo' suudai' u'va jixchamaam kakneer jixchamaam kai'ñ gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' vupui bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Nabal.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook jix dhaav baasɨ'n gu kavɨk gu Dabii aajidha' jix bhai'x ka't.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx juraa'n oidha' jix gaki cham cham tu' ka't bɨx; mi' dhɨr tu' cham bhai' xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios obhɨɨ'ñ gu Dabii gu xibh cham no'ñ bɨx ua'tulhi'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Abigail jix ñi' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Dabii bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt; gio ba' gu Jawatan bhaan tu' ka't uañi'ñ; gu' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios maatɨt gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios.

Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' jano' gu Jawatan gu i'ii'ñ mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Nabal; na gu' jurtu'nka' gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr mɨmɨim gu Nabal bɨɨx; gu' tu' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios cham tu' gu Jawatan tu'.

Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhi' gu ɨ'ɨr gu novɨ; gio ba' ka't na ja'p gu Nabal obhɨɨ'ñ bɨx cham bhai' bhaan gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jano' dhi' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam na tu juan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan jix duñia' gu Jawatan.

Jano' ba' tu' soi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios dhi' uañi'ñ; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tɨɨda' gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan na gu' gu Jawatan duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios cham bhai' cham tu' gaagam tu' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' xoi'kam jix bhai'x ka't jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan ka't gu vupui bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ obhɨɨ'ñ na ja'p tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Jawatan jurtu'nka' bɨx xoi'kam tu' tu ñi'ook tu' bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' ka't dhi' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ cham tu'x jai'ch vaak na jix bhaan gu ɨ'ɨr cham kuiñcha gu Jawatan ka't; na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Abigail; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' bhañ na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ɨ'ɨr gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' na gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' tu' cham tu' jix maa gu xibh cham gu Nabal.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu novɨ ka't; gio ba' jix duñia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu vaak naak gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Abigail suudai' u'va gu Nabal gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ga'ra' gu vaak na ja'p gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu Nabal ka't jix bhai'x ka't gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook tu' jix jai' bɨɨx ka'm suudai' u'va gu tanoolh buimgidhak.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' gu xibh na pai' dhuuk suudai' u'va ka't gu ñi'ook gu Nabal gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ tu'x; gio ba' xoi'kam gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p gu jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n gu Nabal jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix kai gu Nabal ka't jix koi; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Jawatan Dios kuiñcha gu novɨ gu Nabal tu' cham bhai' tu duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Nabal bhaan mo'o; jano' ba' mi' dhɨr bhañ gu Dabii ñiokda' gu Abigail na ba' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii tɨɨtɨs gu Abigail gu Karmelo tu ñi'ook bɨɨx bham; gio ba' gu Dabii tu' na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' jix búup tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu oidha' bham; gio ba' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios na ba' ka't gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tɨɨt tu duukam gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu Abigail bɨɨx jixchamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñchu' gɨ' kavɨk gu ñi'ook chɨ'ɨɨk gu Dabii ka't gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gio jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii gu Ainoam gu Jesreel gu ñi'ook gook jix bɨɨx duu gu u'vɨ.
Na gu' na gu' gu Sauul ka't jix maa mar u'vɨ gu Mikâl gu u'vɨ gu Dabii gu Palti gu mar gu Lais ka't gu Gallim.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Sipeos gu Sauul gu Gabaa bham; gio ba' cham gu Dabii gu jodai' na jix uam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu akîla vupui bhaan oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul jano' ba' jix búup jix dhaav oidha' jix gaki gu Sip gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baidhak vaik jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii oidha' jix gaki gu Sip.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul yooxi' gu akîla vupui bhaan oidha' jix gaki ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' ka't gu Dabii oidha' jix gaki gu Sauul pai' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhañ tɨɨda' gu Sauul ka't tɨbiap.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook pai' gu Sauul ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi'; gio ba' gu Dabii pai' gu Sauul gu Abner gu mar gu Ner ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; mi' dhɨr ka't gu Sauul kookos gu ja'tkam yooxi'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aimelek gu eteo gu Abisai gu mar gu Sarbia xibhɨk gu Joab bham; gio ba' chɨkka jix dhaav gu Sauul yooxi' jix aa' gu Abisai; mi' dhɨr tu' bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Abisai tɨɨtɨs gu ja'tkam gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul ka't kookos u'u kavɨk jix duñia' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu Abner gu ja'tkam mi'p xikoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abisai gu Dabii; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios dhagia' bhaamki'ñdha' gu noobh; mi' dhɨr jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx u'u kavɨk bɨɨx gu oidha' gu ñi'ook cham.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Abisai; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' chɨkka jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh na ba' jix dhaav.
Jano' ba' cham jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ jano' u'u kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii u'u kavɨk gu suudai' gu Sauul jix bɨɨx duu; na cham ka't soo'mchulhdhak tu' bɨx gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix dhaam suudai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan.
Jano' ba' bhɨi gu Dabii baasɨ'n jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk dhaibu jix gɨ' jix bhai'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix maa jiiñak gu Dabii gu ja'tkam gu Abner gu mar gu Ner bham; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook gu Abner jano' ba' gu Abner jix aa'; mi' dhɨr chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jiiñak gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Abner; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ tu' chɨkka cham tu'x jai'ch na ja'p tu' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook cham gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan tu' kia'mi'ñ maa'n gu ja'tkam kooda' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook cham xoi'kam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi'm cham jix duñia' gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jano' duukat u'u kavɨk gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai' ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul gu ñi'ook gu Dabii; gio ba' cham dhi' gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Dabii jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan tu duukam gu ñi'ook cham bhai' cham tu'x jai'ch gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' soi'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ñi'ook tu duukam; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' bhaan tu' gu maa'nkar; gu' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' baas gu ñi'ook na ba' cham gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios bham; jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' jano' gu ɨ'ɨr gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu kakkavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul; gio ba' uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu Dabii cham bhai' tu' gu oidha' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vupui; jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'u kavɨk gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jix bhai'x maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n bɨx bhai'; na gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't dhagia' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu' tu' cham jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu oidha' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vupui ka't gu oidha' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios namkidhat bɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sauul gu Dabii; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu mar gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' tu'; jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't gu bhóogɨt gu Sauul pai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu novɨ gu Sauul; mi' dhɨr cham tu' ka't tutkɨ gu oidha' gu Pilisteos na ba' gu Sauul tu' cham gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu noobh.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ ga'ra' baidhak gu ñi'ook gu Akîs gu mar gu Maok gu gɨ'kora' gu Gat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii bɨɨx gu Akîs gu Gat maa'n bɨɨx ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Dabii bɨɨx gook gu u'vɨ gu Ainoam gu Jesreelita gu Abigail ka't gu u'vɨ gu Nabal gu Karmelo.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul gu Dabii ka't jix duñia' gu Gat cham gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Akîs; gio ba' tu' gaagam jano' nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa pai' jɨ'dɨlh gu oidha' pai' jix duñia'; na gu' tu' tu duukam bɨndak kiicham vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Akîs jix maa mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Siklag; gio ba' ka't gu Siklag gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tanoolh gu Dabii jix daa gu oidha' gu Pilisteos maakobh masaa'n dhɨt gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii bɨɨx bhaan ba'k gu Gesureos gu Gerseos gu Amalekitas; na gu' dhi' ja'tkam oi'ñka' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' dɨr na ja'p tu' gu Sur bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii cham gu oidha' gu chio'ñ tu' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' kakneer gu ñi'ook jix ai; mi' dhɨr gu Akîs.
Jano' ba' chɨtda gu Akîs; gio ba' duukat jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii chɨtda; mi' dhɨr saagi'ñ gu Judaa saagi'ñ gu Jerameel bhaan saagi'ñ gu Keni.

Jano' ba' tu' gu chio'ñ tu' gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Dabii gu Gat; gio ba' bham; na gu' cham jix maa aa'ñdham no'ch bham dhi' jix duu gu Dabii; jano' ba' dhi' ka't bɨx gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' gu Akîs gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel ka't bɨɨx tas tu duukam.

Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu Pilisteos jum daa'ñ vaak ja'tkam na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' jix aa' gu Akîs gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr tɨɨda' jix buus vaak ja'tkam tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Akîs; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Akîs jix aa' gu Dabii; na ba' tu' jix nukadham mo'o bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Samueel ka't jix koi bɨx gu Israeel ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dua'ñ jix duñia' gu Rama kiicham; gio ba' gu Sauul ka't baas gu oidha' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na ja'p gu Pilisteos jum daa'ñ tɨɨtɨs gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu Sunam; gio ba' gu Sauul jum daa'ñ bɨx gu Israeel yooxi' gu Gilboa.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix ñi' gu Sauul yooxi' gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul gu Jawatan Dios; gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix aa' tu' tɨɨtki' tu' gu Urim tu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ na ba' tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham tu'x jai'ch gu u'vɨ gu Endor juraa'n gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul jix dhaas jajannulhi'ñ ka't bɨɨx gook gu chichio'ñ tɨɨtɨs mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ gu tukaa'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' soi'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix tɨ'ɨ tu' tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ñɨidhat gu Sauul tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu oidha' na ba' kooda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios cham bhai' tu' ɨlhdham dhi'.
Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ jano' ba'; gio ba' chɨkka tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Samueel.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu u'vɨ gu Samueel tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ gu Sauul bham.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gu Sauul; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham jum i'obh; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook buupui gu u'vɨ jix aa' gu Sauul; gio ba' buupui gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x jupaabkamu'n jix bhaan dhaas; jano' ba' gu Sauul jano' ba' ka't gu Samueel gu vupui gu oidha' jix duu tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samueel gu Sauul; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Sauul jix aa'; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu Pilisteos bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' cham tu ñi'ook tu' gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' tɨɨtki'; gio ba' dhi' tu' tɨɨgim na ba' gu ñi'ook no'ñ bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samueel; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios bhaamki'ñdha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu novɨ tu' jix maa duiñchu' gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' na ja'p tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' i'iich gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Amalek gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' gu Israeel gio bɨndak gu noobh gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu xibh boopoya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr yooxi' gu Israeel kapbhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu noobh gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul gu oidha' jix gɨ' ka't jix duñia' choo'n gu ñi'ook gu Samueel; na gu' cham na gu' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' cham ka't gu takarui'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ suudai' u'va gu Sauul jimchu' jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu novɨ naak gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tu' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ja'tkam na tu juan; gio ba' tu' vupui bhaan tu' gu chin gu takarui' jugi na ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' cham jugi; gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨma'n bɨɨx gu u'vɨ; jano' ba' jix búup jix daa bhaan.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ ga'ra' gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' cham jabka'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Sauul; gio ba' a'lhiok jix búup mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos jum daa'ñ bɨx vaak ja'tkam gu Apek; gio ba' tu' gu Israeel jix dhaas yooxi' ju'ñdharan suudai' buusñi gu Jesreel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' gu Pilisteos chamaam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu Dabii jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Akîs.

Jano' ba' gui'p chiñia' gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam dhi' ja'tkam gu ebreos gu Akîs jix aa' chiñia' gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii tu duukam gu Sauul gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tu' dhi' dhɨt gu tanoolh dhɨt cham gaagam dɨr gu tanoolh tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' chiñia' gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gui'p; gio ba' dhi' gu chio'ñ jix duñia' pai' nɨi'ñchudat cham bɨɨx no'ch cham ka't jix duñia' bhaamki'ñdha'; na gu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tutkɨ nɨidhidha' gu Jawatan bɨɨx ɨɨbhidham dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham dhi' gu Dabii alabaa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' gu Sauul naaka'n gu Dabii mambhɨɨx.

Ba' jix aa' gu Akîs jup tɨɨt gu Dabii; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam gu ñi'ook ba'k yooxi' matgɨm gaagam tu' dɨr gu tanoolh tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gu' gu vupui chiñia' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ; gio ba' cham cham bhai' gu vupui chiñia' gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Akîs; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gaagam tu duukam dɨr gu tanoolh dhi' bɨndak bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Akîs gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai' gu vupui na ja'p nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gu' chiñia' gu Pilisteos jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham bɨɨx no'ch.
Jano' ba' bamii' gu xibh tu' tu duukam gu Jawatan jix duñia' tɨbiap bɨndak; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii gu xibh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu Pilisteos jix bɨɨx duu gu Jesreel.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨtɨs gu Siklag vaik gu tanoolh gu Amalek saagi'ñ gu Siklag jix bhai'x gu Siklag gu tai.
Jano' ba' dua'ñ baabuk gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ mi'p dɨr jix ali' bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ'; gu' soo'mchulhdhak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koi gu ñi'ook baabuk tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Dabii bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham ka't vaak na jix bhaan gu tai gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook na ba' jix xuaak.
Jano' ba' gook gu u'vɨ gu Dabii gu Ainoam gu Jesreelita gu Abigail ka't gu u'vɨ gu Nabal gu Karmelo gio jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' gu Dabii ka't gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' na gu' gu ja'tkam ua'rgidhimɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim maa'n gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gu' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Abiatar gu mar gu Aimelek; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Abiatar gu ñi'ook gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tɨɨda' cham uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx mi'p tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx ka'm bhi'ñbak gu Besor pai' gu ñi'ook dhɨt.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii chɨ'ɨɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ; na gu' cham gu ñi'ook bhi'ñbak gu Besor.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu chio'ñ gu Egipkio aichdhak gu Dabii jix maa gu takarui' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'i gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix maa gio gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook; gio ba' jix jugi gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ; na gu' cham ka't gu takarui' tu' gu suudai' vaik gu tanoolh vaik gu tukaa'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' duukat jix aa' gu Egipkio; na gu' tu' jix duñia' tu duukam gu Amalekita gu ñi'ook tu' vaik gu tanoolh na gu' ka't ka'ook.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n saagi'ñ gu Kereti gu Judaa saagi'ñ gu Kaleb; gio ba' gu tai gu Siklag.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham koo'nda' tu' kapbhai' gu noobh tu' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' mi'p bhaan gu vupui bɨx mii' dhɨr gu oidha' jugi i'i bɨx mii' dhɨr jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Pilisteos pai' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' naaka'n gu Dabii dɨr mii' dhɨr gu xibh bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai gu tanoolh buimgidhak; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook biipibop jix duñia' jix ai jiboi'ññor.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii bɨx gu Amalekitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Dabii gook gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix gɨ' gu ma'nkam na ja'p ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨx tu'x jix duñia'; gio ba' bɨx gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio gu Dabii bɨx kakneer gu vaakax gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx vupui bhaan am:―Ja'pji; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ jix daa jix duñia' cham jix daa gu Dabii jix daa gu ñi'ook bhi'ñbak gu Besor; gio ba' moor gu Dabii gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Dabii gu ja'tkam tulhiiñdha' bɨɨx bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx tomaat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu Dabii tu ñi'ook gui'p; na gu' cham jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx no'ch cham gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook maa'n gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam tu' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu noobh suudai' u'va bhaan no'ch.
Na gu' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' na gu' baasɨ'n tu' jupaabkamu'n bɨɨx; na bɨɨma'n.
Jano' ba' dɨr mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix duñia' ka't dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga jir bɨx bhai' gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Siklag bhañ daraa gu Judaa bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook obhɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu Bet-el gu Ramot saagi'ñ mi'p gu Jattir.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu Aroer gu Sipmot mi'p gu Estemoa.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu Rakâl mi'p jɨ'dɨlh gu Jerameel mi'p jɨ'dɨlh gu Kineo.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu orma mi'p gu Kôrasaan mi'p gu Atak.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu ebroon bɨx pai' gu Dabii ka't dhi' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Israeel jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan gu Pilisteos ia'rɨ koko'kam gu kavɨk gu Gilboa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteos gu Sauul gu ma'nkam gu Jonataan gu Abinadab gu Melkîsua gu ma'nkam gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Sauul; gio ba' jix duñia' choo'n.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul kutun kavɨk; na gu' jix buusñi gu kuchii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx na gu' cham dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu' kutun kavɨk cham na gu' ga'ra' choo'n; jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Sauul gu kuchii bhaan.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ kutun kavɨk gu Sauul jix koi gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu kuchii jix koi bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Sauul mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨɨma'n bɨɨx vaik gu ma'nkam kutun kavɨk bɨx gu chio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu Israeel jix duñia' baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu Jordaan ñɨi'ñ gu Israeel ka't jix duñia' gu Sauul gu ma'nkam jix duñia' koko'kam gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh jiboi'ññor; gio ba' gu Pilisteos tɨɨtɨs jix daa.
Jano' ba' ka't buimgidhak gu tanoolh bai'ñpu' gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koko'kam gu ñi'ook gu Sauul vaik gu ma'nkam gu kavɨk gu Gilboa.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mo'o gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mɨjɨ gu oidha' gu Pilisteos na ba' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan duiñxim gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Astarot gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug vaak jodai gu Bet-san.
Gu' gu' tɨiñ gu Jabes gu Galaad dhi' gu Pilisteos jix duu gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' gu chuukug gu Sauul gu chuukug gu ma'nkam vaak jodai gu Bet-san; gio ba' bai'ñpu' gu Jabes gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhaagɨk o'oo gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu u'u gu Jabes gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
